evidence: Fig. 1: Overview of the simulation-to-real framework. (A) Stage 1: training the human policy to reproduce recorded responses to backward-translation perturbations. (B) Stage 2: training the exoskeleton controller to reduce CoM excursion and increase the balance threshold of the simulated human. (C) Deployment of the trained balance-assistive controller on an ankle exoskeleton. The policy receives on-board sensor inputs and outputs a torque command.
